te: The trial of Joan of Arc begins in Rouen.
de: The trial of Joan of Arc begins in Rouen.

t: 在法国鲁昂，19 岁的圣女贞德被英国主导的法庭烧死在火刑柱上。
te: In Rouen, France, the 19-year-old Joan of Arc is burned at the stake by an English-dominated tribunal.
dz: 百年战争：在法国鲁昂，19 岁的圣女贞德被英国主导的法庭烧死在火刑柱上。
de: Hundred Years' War: In Rouen, France, the 19-year-old Joan of Arc is burned at the stake by an English-dominated tribunal.

dz: 拉希格鲁埃拉战役(英语:Battle of La Higeruela)发生在格拉纳达,导致卡斯蒂利亚王国在收复战争期间略为推进.
de: The Battle of La Higueruela takes place in Granada, leading to a modest advance of the Kingdom of Castile during the Reconquista.

t: 匈牙利人击败胡斯泰克军队.
te: The Hungarians defeat the Hussite army.
dz: 伊拉瓦战役:匈牙利人击败胡斯泰克军队.
de: The Battle of Ilava: The Hungarians defeat the Hussite army.

t: 英国亨利六世在巴黎圣母院加冕为法国国王。
te: Henry VI of England is crowned King of France at Notre Dame in Paris.
dz: 百年战争：英国亨利六世在巴黎圣母院加冕为法国国王。
de: Hundred Years' War: Henry VI of England is crowned King of France at Notre Dame in Paris.
